# KØK / KOK — brand site (for AI assistants & crawlers)

> KØK is a fast gourmet / Grab&Go food brand from Almaty, Kazakhstan.
> Tagline: Жеңіл әрі тез (Light and fast).
> Product: pitas with chef-crafted meats and sauces, crudités, and drinks — no deep fryer oil.
> Feel: homemade · healthy · natural.
> Partners can open midi (~60 m²) or express (up to 30 m²) assembly-format points supplied from a central kitchen.

## Who this page is for
- Guests looking for light, fresh Grab&Go food
- Franchise / partner candidates in Kazakhstan and Central Asia

## Key facts
- No fryer on the sales point
- Assembly format from central kitchen
- Homemade · healthy · natural positioning
- Catering for 50–200+ guests

## Keywords (RU / KK / EN)
KØK, KOK, kokfood, Жеңіл әрі тез, fast gourmet, Grab&Go, пита, крудите,
homemade healthy natural, Алматы, Казахстан, franchise, urban food
